id: \bWhy not join me in the water?
en: \bWhy not join me in the water?

id: \bJuan uses Water type Pokémon. They are weak against Grass and Electric types.
en: \bJuan uses Water type Pokémon. They are weak against Grass and Electric types.
it: \bRodrigo usa Pokémon di tipo Acqua. Sono deboli contro i tipi Erba ed Elettro.

id: \bThey are strong against Fire, Ground, and Rock. Fire, Ice, Steel, and Water moves also don't do much damage.
en: \bThey are strong against Fire, Ground, and Rock.  Fire, Ice, Steel, and Water moves also don't do much damage.
it: \bSono forti contro Fuoco, Terra e Roccia.  Anche le mosse di tipo Fuoco, Ghiaccio, Acciaio e Acqua non fanno molti danni.

id: \rI can't believe I'm here right now!
en: \rI can't believe I'm here right now!
it: \rNon ci credo che sono qui in questo momento!

id: \bJuan: Welcome! You'll need at least two Pokémon if you want to battle me. Please come back when you're ready.
en: \bJuan: Welcome! You'll need at least two Pokémon if you want to battle me. Please come back when you're ready.
it: \bRodrigo: Benvenuto! Ti servono almeno due Pokémon se vuoi sfidarmi. Torna quando sarai pronto.

id: \bJuan: Welcome to the Sootopolis Gym. Here you shall bear witness to our artistry. A grand illusion of water sculpted by Pokémon and myself!
en: \bJuan: Welcome to the Sootopolis Gym. Here you shall bear witness to our artistry. A grand illusion of water sculpted by Pokémon and myself!
it: \bRodrigo: Benvenuto nella Palestra di Ceneride. Qui sarai testimone della nostra arte. Una grandiosa illusione d'acqua scolpita dai Pokémon e da me!

id: \bI hope you're prepared, because this Gym battle is going to involve two different stages.
en: \bI hope you're prepared, because this Gym battle is going to involve two different stages.
it: \bSpero che tu sia preparato, perché questa lotta in Palestra si svolgerà in due fasi.

id: \bThe first will be a double battle involving two of my Pokémon. When you beat them we move on to phase two, which is a single battle.
en: \bThe first will be a double battle involving two of my Pokémon. When you beat them we move on to phase two, which is a single battle.
it: \bLa prima sarà una lotta in doppio con due dei miei Pokémon. Quando li avrai sconfitti passeremo alla seconda fase, una lotta singola.

id: \bJuan: Very good. Onto the second battle.
en: \bJuan: Very good. Onto the second battle.
it: \bRodrigo: Molto bene. Passiamo alla seconda lotta.
\bRodrigo: Ti sei meritato la Medaglia Pioggia.

id: \bTM96 contains Razor Shell. It has a chance to lower the opponent's defense.
en: \bTM96 contains Razor Shell. It has a chance to lower the opponent's defense.
it: \bL'MT96 contiene Conchilama. Può ridurre la Difesa del bersaglio.

id: \bJuan: I wish you luck in your league challenge. Feel free to stop by if you ever wish to see a master performer.
en: \bJuan: I wish you luck in your league challenge. Feel free to stop by if you ever wish to see a master performer.
it: \bRodrigo: Ti auguro buona fortuna nella sfida alla Lega. Passa pure a trovarmi se mai vorrai ammirare un maestro dell'esibizione.
